name: Harry Reid

summary.text: Harry Reid was a Democratic U.S. Senator from Nevada and Senate Majority Leader. Beginning in 2007 he pushed Senators Ted Stevens and Daniel Inouye of the Appropriations Committee to place about $22 million in the Pentagon's classified budget for a Defense Intelligence Agency study of unexplained aerial phenomena, later known as AATIP/AAWSAP; the contract went to his friend Robert Bigelow's company. In June 2009 he asked the DIA to give the program special access protection, which the agency declined. He defended the program publicly, saying in 2019 he was not embarrassed by it.

facts.claim: In December 2017 the Pentagon confirmed that the program Reid had helped fund existed, with spending of about $22 million, and said it ended in the 2012 timeframe because other, higher-priority issues merited funding.
facts.quote: The Advanced Aviation Threat Identification Program ended in the 2012 time frame

connections.claim: Reid said his friend Robert Bigelow, who knew of his interest, offered to prepare a 'strictly science' study framework when Reid asked how to approach Senate spending on the subject; the resulting contract went to Bigelow's company.

connections.claim: Reid sought the appropriation that funded the DIA's AAWSAP contract, which was awarded to Bigelow Aerospace Advanced Space Studies, and in 2009 asked the DIA to give that contract special access protection. KLAS-TV reported that Reid did not influence the DIA's selection of the contractor.
connections.quote: Harry Reid did not influence the selection process.
